clue.text: Order coroner may refuse to acknowledge

definitions.meaning: a coroner may order that a body be opened up, i.e. that the deceased be cut for a post-mortem
to snub someone completely by ignoring them when you meet

explanation.walkthrough: The first reading is whimsical: a coroner investigating a death might order an autopsy, cutting the dead.
explanation.definitionFit: To cut someone dead is an idiom for a deliberate snub, and humorously also what a coroner might order for a corpse.

clue.text: Large bell dropped by one without discretion

definitions.meaning: a big bell is something that clangs loudly
a tactless person drops a blunder, an embarrassing gaffe

explanation.walkthrough: To 'drop a clanger' is a British idiom for making an embarrassing, tactless mistake.
explanation.definitionFit: A clanger is literally a thing that clangs, and idiomatically a gaffe that a tactless person 'drops'.

clue.text: Counter-offensive leads to defeat

indicators.note: an offensive is an attack, so the word Counter is broken up and rearranged

explanation.surface: A military counter-attack ends in the enemy's rout.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Counter-offensive' reads as one military term, but 'offensive' is the anagram signal acting on COUNTER; 'leads to' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: To trounce is to beat heavily, a synonym for defeating soundly.

clue.text: Bill is embraced by the first woman to escape

indicators.note: being embraced means being held inside, so the bill goes within the woman's name

parts.note: Eve is the first woman in the Bible
AD is short for advertisement, a bill or poster

explanation.surface: Someone running from a debt hides behind Eve, the first woman.
explanation.definitionFit: To evade is to dodge or slip away from, a synonym of escape.

clue.text: Taking cold turkey and removing moisture

definitions.meaning: going through withdrawal from alcohol or drugs
making something dry, as laundry on a line

explanation.definitionFit: Drying out is the idiom for an addict's withdrawal, and literally the loss of wetness.

clue.text: Faithless man evicted from the Athenian Assembly

indicators.note: the answer is pushed out of the run of letters in the following words

explanation.surface: An unbeliever is thrown out of the democratic assembly in ancient Athens.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters sit across 'the Athenian': tHE ATHENian.
explanation.definitionFit: A heathen is someone with no religion, an unbeliever.

clue.text: Entertainer receives money from composer

indicators.note: receiving means taking something in, so the host's letters hold the money

parts.note: a host entertains guests
L stands for the pound sterling, a unit of money

explanation.surface: A performer gets paid by a composer.
explanation.walkthrough: Gustav Holst was the English composer of The Planets.
explanation.definitionFit: Gustav Holst was an English classical musician who wrote The Planets suite.

clue.text: French aid offered anew? The devil it is!

indicators.note: presenting something in a new form, so the letters of French aid are rearranged

explanation.surface: A sardonic comment on a fresh foreign aid package from France being devilish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'it is' is a link word making the clue read as an exclamation.
explanation.definitionFit: The archfiend is Satan, chief of the devils.

clue.text: Plant is a cause of distress to fowl

parts.note: a hen is a domestic fowl
a bane is a source of harm or misery

explanation.surface: A poisonous plant is a menace to chickens.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue gives the bane first and the fowl second, but in the answer the fowl comes first.
explanation.definitionFit: Henbane is a poisonous herb of the nightshade family.

clue.text: Remedy for broken guitar strings?

parts.note: a cure-all whose name, split into two words, says playing chords is impossible once the strings are snapped

explanation.walkthrough: Split the answer after its second letter: with broken strings, a guitarist cannot sweep the chords at all.
explanation.definitionFit: A nostrum is a quack medicine or pet cure, a remedy.

clue.text: Irregularity means loan may be renegotiated

indicators.note: terms renegotiated are rearranged, so the letters of loan may are reordered

explanation.surface: A banking oddity means a loan's terms might have to be revised.
explanation.definitionFit: An anomaly is a deviation from the normal, something irregular.

clue.text: Copper lodged in damaged nasal cavities

indicators.note: something lodged in is stuck inside, so the copper goes into the rearranged letters
something damaged is knocked out of shape, so the letters of nasal are rearranged

parts.note: Cu is the chemical symbol for copper

explanation.surface: A copper fragment is stuck in a patient's injured nasal passages.
explanation.walkthrough: 'damaged' looks like a description of the nasal passages, but it is the anagram signal; 'lodged in' then places the copper symbol between the third and fourth letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Lacunae or lacunas are gaps or small hollows, i.e. cavities, in anatomy.

clue.text: Redhead takes biscuit

definitions.meaning: ginger means red-haired, and nut is slang for head
a crisp ginger-flavoured cookie popular in Britain

explanation.surface: A red-haired person helps themselves to a cookie.
explanation.walkthrough: A ginger nut is a hard British ginger biscuit; 'nut' is slang for head and 'ginger' for red-haired.
explanation.definitionFit: Read as ginger plus head-slang it names a red-haired person, and it is also a spiced British cookie.

clue.text: Left in just because of one's skill

indicators.note: the letter for left goes inside the word for just

parts.note: just means fair, as in fair-minded

explanation.surface: Someone kept their place on merit alone, purely thanks to their talent.
explanation.definitionFit: Flair is natural talent or aptitude.

clue.text: Discharge a man stuck into hard liquor

indicators.note: the man's pronoun is pushed inside the spirit

parts.note: rum is a strong spirit
he is the pronoun for a man

explanation.surface: A man has thrown himself into heavy drinking.
explanation.definitionFit: Rheum is a watery mucous discharge from the eyes or nose.

clue.text: Novelist makes an impression on couple

parts.note: a mark is an impression left on a surface
twain is an old word for two, a pair

explanation.surface: A writer leaves his mark on a pair of people.
explanation.walkthrough: Mark Twain was the American author of Tom Sawyer; 'makes' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Mark Twain is the pen name of the American author Samuel Clemens.

clue.text: Correct place for a torchbearer to fix his gaze

definitions.meaning: on target, exactly right, like a pilot following a radio guide signal

definitions.text: place for a torchbearer to fix his gaze
definitions.meaning: someone holding a torch looks along its shaft of light

explanation.walkthrough: 'On the beam' originally meant flying along a radio guidance signal, hence on course or correct.
explanation.definitionFit: Being on the beam is an idiom for being on track or right, and literally where a torch-holder looks.

clue.text: Expel seaman as the result of a policy change

definitions.text: the result of a policy change

parts.note: split into an instruction, the answer tells you to throw an able seaman out: to turn out is to expel, and AB is a seaman

explanation.surface: Sacking a sailor turns out to be a reversal of policy.
explanation.walkthrough: This works backwards: the answer, read as a command with the seaman's abbreviation in the middle, means 'expel seaman'; 'as' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: A turnabout is a reversal of position or opinion, a U-turn in policy.

clue.text: Last month's speaker was a tradesman

parts.note: December, abbreviated DEC, is the last month of the year
an orator is a public speaker

explanation.surface: The person who gave last month's talk turned out to be a manual worker.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Last month' means the final month of the year, not the month before this one; 'was a' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A decorator, painter and paperhanger, is a skilled tradesman.

clue.text: Enticing picture

definitions.meaning: attracting, as in pulling in a crowd
a sketch or illustration

explanation.definitionFit: Drawing means attracting, as in drawing a crowd, and is also a sketch.

clue.text: Odysseus was enthralled by her song

definitions.meaning: the nymph in Homer who held Odysseus captive on her island for seven years
a Caribbean musical style from Trinidad

explanation.definitionFit: Calypso is the nymph who detained Odysseus in the Odyssey, and also a West Indian ballad style.

clue.text: Put off by seeing the German swallow iron

indicators.note: swallowing takes something inside, so the German article holds the iron

parts.note: der is a German word for the
Fe is the chemical symbol for iron

explanation.surface: Someone is postponing because a German has gulped down some iron.
explanation.definitionFit: To defer is to postpone or delay.

clue.text: A gamble makes the heart beat faster

definitions.meaning: a small bet, as on a horse
a rapid irregular beating, as of the heart in palpitation

explanation.walkthrough: 'Have a flutter' is British for placing a modest bet.
explanation.definitionFit: A flutter is British slang for a small wager, and also a quick palpitation of the heart.

clue.text: Ray got weary and hit the hay

parts.note: ray, or re, is the second note of the sol-fa scale
tired means weary

explanation.surface: Ray was exhausted and went to bed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Ray' looks like a man's name but is the musical note re in sol-fa (do, re, mi).
explanation.definitionFit: Retired means went to bed, as does the idiom hit the hay.

clue.text: Designate a large item for auction

parts.note: L is the abbreviation for large, as on clothing sizes
a lot is an item put up for sale at auction

explanation.surface: An auctioneer marks out a big piece for the sale.
explanation.definitionFit: To allot is to assign or earmark, synonymous with designate.

clue.text: Take the blame for mistake in the rhythm

definitions.meaning: to be responsible for an error
a fault in the beat of music

explanation.definitionFit: To be at fault is to be culpable, and split differently it reads as a flaw in the musical pulse.

clue.text: Bishop has less to thank the Lord for

parts.note: B is the chess notation for bishop

explanation.surface: A bishop has fewer reasons to be grateful to God.
explanation.definitionFit: To bless something can mean to give thanks to God for it, as in blessing a meal.

clue.text: Fast London river

definitions.meaning: swift, quick
a river in London that now runs underground beneath ... Street

explanation.definitionFit: Fleet means swift, and the Fleet is a buried river in London that gave its name to Fleet Street.

clue.text: Appropriate spot for the glitterati to socialise

definitions.meaning: fitting, in its proper position

definitions.text: spot for the glitterati to socialise
definitions.meaning: a fashionable venue, a trendy place where celebrities gather

explanation.definitionFit: In place means fitting or arranged, and read differently it is a trendy venue where celebrities gather.

clue.text: Not the hotel for a newly appointed senator

indicators.note: freshly appointed suggests arrangement, so the letters of senator are rearranged

explanation.surface: A cheap hotel would not suit a freshly elected senator.
explanation.walkthrough: A one-star hotel is the most basic grade, so it is not the hotel for a dignitary; 'for a' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A one-star establishment is the lowest rated, hardly a suitable lodging for a VIP.

clue.text: Reasons for having land around the house

definitions.meaning: justifications, as in ... for complaint
the gardens and estate surrounding a mansion

explanation.definitionFit: Grounds means justifications, and also the estate surrounding a big building.

clue.text: Do utter out as you're taught

indicators.note: out signals that the letters of Do utter are disordered

explanation.surface: Speak up as you've been instructed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out' is the anagram signal on DO UTTER; 'as you're' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Tutored means taught privately, coached.
